extracted.intended_audience: issuers of qualified health plans (QHPs), State exchanges and SBE-FPs, agents/brokers/web-brokers, State and Federal policymakers, CMS program officers, and public commenters to the CMS proposed rule
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of the evaluation/implementation standards and regulatory criteria in CMS's proposed Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027 (and Basic Health Program) to inform comments and compliance. The page enumerates proposed regulatory standards across Parts 150, 153, 154, 155, 156, and 158 and associated information-collection requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factors CMS Uses To Determine the Amount of a Civil Money Penalty (CMP) (§150.317)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and factors CMS would use to determine the amount of a CMP imposed under Part 150.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes discussion of bases and processes for imposing CMPs and cross-references to related authorities; CMPs may be imposed if credible evidence shows issuer engaged in actions listed under §156.805(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS Risk Adjustment — Data for Model Recalibration (2027 Benefit Year) (§153.320)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification of the data to be used for recalibrating the HHS risk adjustment model for the 2027 benefit year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists types of data, time frames, and analytic considerations CMS proposes to use for recalibration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed List of Factors To Be Employed in the HHS Risk Adjustment Models (§153.320)
rubrics_metrics.description: The set of demographic, diagnostic, and other factors proposed to be included in the HHS risk adjustment model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rationale and solicitation of comment on each proposed factor's inclusion and impact on model performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS Risk Adjustment — Model Performance Statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Performance metrics and statistics CMS will use to evaluate risk-adjustment model performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes model fit measures and comparisons across model specifications; used to justify recalibration choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of the HHS Risk Adjustment Methodology (§153.320)
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of methodology CMS uses for HHS-operated risk adjustment, including modeling approach and transfer calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides conceptual overview, technical decisions, and areas where CMS seeks comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment Solicitation on Retaining Separate Risk Adjustment Transfer Calculations for Individual Catastrophic Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for public comment on whether to retain separate transfer calculations for individual catastrophic vs. non-catastrophic plans under the State payment transfer formula.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains tradeoffs and asks stakeholders to provide data and reasoning to inform decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk Adjustment Data Validation Requirements When HHS Operates Risk Adjustment (HHS-RADV) (§§153.350 and 153.630)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for validating risk adjustment data when HHS operates the risk adjustment program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies documentation, sampling, error thresholds, and issuer responsibilities under HHS-RADV.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS-RADV Error Estimation Modification To Incorporate IVA Sampling Changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed methodological changes to how HHS-RADV estimates error to reflect changes in IVA (independent verification/audit) sampling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes statistical adjustments and seeks comment on sampling implications for error estimation.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS Risk Adjustment User Fee for the 2027 Benefit Year (§153.610(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification of the user fee HHS will charge for operating risk adjustment for the 2027 benefit year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes fee calculation approach and proposed rates for issuers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of Rate Filing Justification (§154.215)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for health insurance issuers to submit rate filing justifications for rate increases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses required supporting materials such as URRTs, actuarial memos, CSR reimbursement accounting, and related ICRs; CMS encourages submission of supporting facts and evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rate Filing Justifications Regarding Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSRs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific information issuers must provide in rate filings to explain CSR load and CSR-related factors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes instructions for estimating CSR load factor and related information-collection burdens (ICR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized Plan Options (§§155.20, 155.205(b)(1), 155.220(c)(3)(i)(H), 156.201, 156.265(b)(3)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal regarding the availability, design, and discontinuation of standardized plan options on Exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses regulatory history, current proposal, rationale, and implications including plan discontinuations and ICRs if discontinued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval of a State Exchange (§155.105)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and standards for approving a State Exchange to operate under Exchange rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specific requirements a State must meet to be approved and ongoing obligations; discussed in two separate proposed provisions (§155.105 and §155.106).

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval of a State Exchange (§155.106)
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional or complementary approval criteria and procedures for State Exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses administrative and technical requirements and CMS oversight expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amending Requirements for State Exchanges To Operate a Centralized Eligibility and Enrollment Infrastructure (§155.205(b) and 155.221(k))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed amendments to require or modify State Exchange responsibilities for centralized eligibility and enrollment platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes sub-proposals about consumer interfaces and SBE-Enhanced Direct Enrollment options and associated technical and operational standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBE-Enhanced Direct Enrollment Option (§155.221(k))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to allow a State-based Exchange on the Federal platform to offer an enhanced direct enrollment pathway for entities enrolling consumers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes operational standards, consumer protections, and interaction with state oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Required Benefits (§155.170)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards regarding State-required benefits beyond Essential Health Benefits that QHPs must cover when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies State payment responsibilities and plan coverage expectations where States mandate additional benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability of States To Permit Agents, Brokers, and Web-Brokers To Assist Enrollees (§155.220(j))
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and limits for allowing agents, brokers, and web-brokers to help qualified individuals and employers enroll in QHPs and assist with APTC/CSR applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proposed mandates for an HHS-approved consumer consent form, a standard eligibility application review form, standards of conduct, marketing standards, and administrative enforcement provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposals Related to FFE Standards of Conduct and Mandating Standard Eligibility Application Review and Consumer Consent Forms (§155.220(j)(2) and (j)(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific proposals to require standardized forms and codes of conduct for enrollment assistance entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes ICRs for mandating HHS-created forms and describes potential administrative penalties for noncompliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of the Vendor Program (§155.222)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to remove the Exchange vendor program and associated requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains rationale and operational impact on Exchanges and technology vendors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit Advance Premium Tax Credit (APTC) Eligibility to 'Eligible Noncitizens' (§155.20; §155.305(f)(1); §155.320(c)(3); 42 CFR 600.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to restrict eligibility for APTC to individuals classified as 'eligible noncitizens' in specified regulatory provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses data-match implications, implementation costs, and ICRs for new DMI (data-match issue) types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disallow APTC for Individuals Ineligible for Medicaid Due to Immigration Status and With Income Below 100% FPL (§155.305(f)(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to prohibit APTC eligibility for certain individuals who are ineligible for Medicaid because of immigration status and whose income falls below 100% of the FPL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains policy rationale and anticipated effect on enrollment and subsidies; includes associated ICRs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure To File and Reconcile (FTR) Policy (§155.305)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and enforcement standards for issuers or entities that fail to file required data or reconcile information (FTR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes potential sanctions and administrative processes tied to failure to file/reconcile requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility Verification Provisions (WFTC Section 71303) — Comment Solicitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Solicits comments on how to implement eligibility verification provisions enacted in the Working Families Tax Cut (WFTC) legislation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asks for stakeholder input on operationalizing verification and associated impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Income Verification Policy When Data Sources Indicate Income Less Than 100% of the FPL (§155.320(c)(3)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed approach for handling situations when administrative data sources show an enrollee's income below 100% FPL, affecting APTC/CSR eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses verification steps, treatment of attestations, and potential program integrity measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of Requirement To Accept Attestations of Household Income When Tax Data Is Unavailable (§155.320(c)(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to eliminate acceptance of self-attested household income when tax data are unavailable for verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains alternative verification mechanisms and burden considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment Solicitation on Premium Payment Threshold (§155.400)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for comment on the appropriate premium payment threshold policy for Exchanges and enrollee eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks empirical input on thresholds and operational considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extend Removal of the 150 Percent FPL Special Enrollment Period (SEP) Beyond Plan Year 2026 (§155.420(d)(16))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to continue the removal of the 150% FPL-based SEP for enrollment beyond the 2026 plan year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses equity and administrative impacts and requests comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special Enrollment Period Verification (§155.420(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: Verification standards and procedures for Special Enrollment Period eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies documentation, review processes, and potential for pre-enrollment verification (and associated ICRs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expansion of Hardship Exemption Eligibility (§155.605(d)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed expansion and codification of categories eligible for hardship exemptions from individual responsibility or other eligibility barriers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes criteria, documentation, and impacts on subsidy eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amending Exchange Network Adequacy Standards (§155.1050)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed amendments to Exchange network adequacy standards applicable to QHP certification and oversight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes alignment with provider access reviews and potential deferral to State review programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective Essential Community Provider (ECP) Review Program (§155.1051)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to implement an effective ECP review program to ensure QHP networks include sufficient essential community providers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes reducing minimum percentage thresholds (from 35% to 20%), modifying narrative justification requirements, and describing program implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Program Integrity and Oversight Requirements (§155.1200)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for program integrity, oversight, and enforcement across Exchange and QHP operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers monitoring, reporting, corrective actions, and coordination between States and HHS.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Exchange Improper Payment Measurement (SEIPM) (§155.1600–155.1650)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishment of SEIPM with definitions, applicability, information submission, sampling, determination of payment errors, difference resolution and appeals, corrective action plans (CAPs), and compliance consequences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed procedural rules for exchanges to measure improper payments, minimize duplicate audits, and administrate appeal and CAP processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: FFE and SBE-FP User Fee Rates for the 2027 Benefit Year (§156.50)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed user fee rate percentages charged to QHP issuers operating on the Federally-facilitated Exchange (FFE) and State-based Exchanges on the Federal Platform (SBE-FPs) for 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presents fee-rate calculations and rationale for proposed rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitting Plan-Level Adjustments for Multi-Year Catastrophic Plans (§156.80(d)(2)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowing insurers to make plan-level adjustments for catastrophic plans that span multiple consecutive years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains approval criteria and protections for consumers during multi-year plan terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Selection of EHB-Benchmark Plan (§156.111)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and standards by which States select an Essential Health Benefit benchmark plan for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2020.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies process, timing, and consequences for benchmark selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of Essential Health Benefits (§156.115(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing how issuers must provide EHBs, including scope and non-discrimination requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References statutory directives to reflect balance among 10 EHB categories and to avoid discriminatory design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of 2027 Premium Adjustment Percentage and Cost-Sharing Parameters (§156.130(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to publish parameters such as the premium adjustment percentage, maximum annual limitation on cost sharing, reduced maximum annual limit, and required contribution percentage for 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies publication format and timing via guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-Year Terms for Catastrophic Plans (§§156.130(c) and 156.155(a)(6))
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions enabling catastrophic plans to have plan terms lasting up to 10 consecutive years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses consumer protections, actuarial implications, and plan continuity considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-Sharing for Bronze and Catastrophic Plans (§156.136 and 156.155)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for cost-sharing parameters and actuarial value (AV) calculations for Bronze and catastrophic plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the three major components of AV calculation, rates of change, statutory adherence, and an incremental approach to setting parameters; includes specific Bronze and catastrophic plan requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Standardized Plan Option Limits (§156.202)
rubrics_metrics.description: Limits and exception rules for non-standardized plan options offered through Exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes allowable deviations, exception processes, and impact on QHP certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deferral of Network Adequacy Reviews to States With Effective Provider Access Review Programs (§156.230 and §155.1050)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to allow CMS to defer network adequacy review to States that have effective provider access review programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies criteria for deferral and required State program elements to qualify.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential Community Provider Standards for Network Plans (§156.235) and Implementation of Effective ECP Review Program (§155.1051)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for minimum ECP participation in QHP networks and mechanisms to implement an effective ECP review program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposes reducing minimum threshold from 35% to 20%, modifying narrative justification requirements, and describing review program mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: QHP Certification of Non-Network Plans (§§155.1050, 155.1051, 156.230, 156.235, 156.236, 156.275, and 156.810)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals governing certification of non-network plans as QHPs, reconsideration of prohibitions, and an alternative regulatory standard for non-network plans (§156.236).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses prior rulemaking, rationales for reconsideration, proposed standards for effective provider access and ECP review for non-network plans, and potential exceptions or conditions for certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthening HHS Oversight of Advanced Payments of the Premium Tax Credit, CSRs, and User Fee Programs (§156.480)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to clarify and strengthen HHS' compliance review and oversight authority over advanced PTCs, CSRs, and user-fee administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes description of audit, corrective action, and enforcement mechanisms (e.g., requirement to comply with final audit reports and provide CAPs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Factors Considered in Determining the Amount of CMPs and HHS' Authority To Impose CMPs Against Issuers (§156.805)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing of factors HHS will consider when determining CMP amounts and the statutory/regulatory authority to impose CMPs on issuers in Exchanges and SBE-FPs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides examples, legal citations, and procedural safeguards (e.g., CMPs paid to the Secretary and available without appropriation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Review of QHP Issuer Sanctions (§§156.903 and 156.935)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for administrative review of sanctions imposed on QHP issuers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies appeal rights, administrative processes, and timing of reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Standards: Quality Improvement Strategy (§156.1130)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for QHPs to maintain and report on a Quality Improvement Strategy (QIS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details elements of QIS, submission/approval process, and related ICRs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Netting and Establishment of Debt Regulations To Include CMPs (§156.1215)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rules on netting and establishment of debt procedures that apply to CMPs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains timing, repayment, and resolution of payment inaccuracies (including 3-year window for APTC underpayments/repayments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Correction To Cross Reference (§156.1220(b)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: A technical regulatory correction to an existing cross-reference in the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minor drafting correction to ensure internal consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment Solicitation on Potential Adjustment to the Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) for a State's Individual Market (Part 158, Subpart C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for public comment on potential MLR adjustments for state individual markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses factors that might warrant adjustment and invites evidence and analysis from stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection of Information Requirements — Wage Estimates and ICRs (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification and description of information-collection requirements (ICRs) and associated estimated respondent burden and wage estimates across proposed provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes numerous ICRs across parts 154, 155, 156, and 158 with OMB control numbers referenced and invites PRA-related comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICR Regarding Rate Filing Justification — OMB Control Number 0938-1141 (§154.215 and related)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information collection burden associated with submitting rate filing justifications, URRTs, actuarial memoranda, and CSR estimation materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breaks down components such as CSR load factor methodology and submission of unified rate review templates (URRTs).

rubrics_metrics.name: ICR Regarding Mandating HHS-Approved and -Created Consumer Consent Form (§155.220)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden estimates and information needed if CMS mandates HHS-created consumer consent and eligibility application review forms for enrollment assistors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines time and documentation burdens for agents/brokers/web-brokers and Exchanges.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICR Regarding Misleading Marketing (§155.220)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information collection related to preventing and documenting misleading marketing practices by agents, brokers, and web-brokers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies documentation requirements and possible reporting obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding State Exchange Enhanced Direct Enrollment (SBE-EDE) Option (§155.221)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-collection burdens for States and entities implementing the SBE-Enhanced Direct Enrollment option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers compliance, consumer protections, and technical implementation reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Limiting APTC Eligibility to 'Eligible Noncitizens' (§§155.20, 155.305(f)(1), and 155.320)
rubrics_metrics.description: ICRs reflecting burden and processing changes related to limiting APTC eligibility to eligible noncitizens, including new DMI types and data-matching processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details expected implementation costs, ongoing burdens, and data-processing changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Prohibition of APTC for Individuals Ineligible for Medicaid Due to Immigration Status and Income <100% FPL (§155.305(f)(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-collection burdens tied to implementing prohibition of APTC for certain immigrants with incomes under 100% FPL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes expected exchange burdens, DMI handling, and reduced ongoing burdens tied to certain data matches.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Failure To File and Reconcile (§155.305)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden estimates for entities to comply with FTR policies, including filing, reconciliation, and possible remediation actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes administrative impact and expected time costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Income Verification When Data Sources Indicate Income <100% FPL (§155.320(c)(3)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection burdens tied to verification procedures when administrative data indicate very low income, impacting eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains verification steps and documentation burdens.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Income Verification When Tax Data Is Unavailable (§155.320(c)(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden and procedural implications of proposed removal of acceptance of attestations when tax data is unavailable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies alternative documentation and processing burdens.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Pre-Enrollment SEP Verification (§155.420(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-collection burdens associated with pre-enrollment verification of Special Enrollment Period eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details evidence types, timing, and administrative burden estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Expansion of Hardship Exemption Eligibility (§155.605(d)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for processing and documenting expanded hardship exemption categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes documentation and processing time estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Amendment of Exchange Network Adequacy Standards (§155.1050)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden estimates for Exchanges and States to implement amended network adequacy standards and related reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers data collection, submission, and review processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding General Program Integrity and Oversight Requirements (§155.1200)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden associated with increased program-integrity reporting and oversight activities by Exchanges and issuers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details anticipated reporting frequency and resource needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding the State Exchange Improper Payment Measurement (SEIPM) (§§155.1600–155.1650)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-collection burden for SEIPM implementation: definitions, sampling procedures, information submission, error determination, appeals and CAPs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes phases of SEIPM preparation and efforts to minimize duplicate audits; describes failure-to-comply consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Discontinuation of Standardized Plan Options (§§155.20, 155.205(b)(1), 155.220(c)(3)(i)(H), 156.201, and 156.265(b)(3)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden estimates if standardized plan options are discontinued, including notifications and related data collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains impact on issuers, Exchanges, and consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Non-Standardized Plan Option Limits (§156.202)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden estimate for implementing or changing limits on non-standardized plan options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers documentation and certification steps for exceptions and limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Provider Access Standards for Network Plans (§155.1050 and §156.230)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-collection burdens tied to provider access reviews and documentation for network plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies evidence types, review cadence, and applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Essential Community Providers (§155.1051 and §156.235)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden estimates associated with documenting ECP participation and narrative justifications when thresholds are modified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes data collection for ECP lists and network composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding QHP Certification of Non-Network Plans (§§155.1050, 156.230, 156.235, 156.236, 156.275, and 156.810)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-collection burdens for certifying non-network plans as QHPs under proposed alternative standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details evidence, review processes, and potential corrective actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Quality Improvement Strategy (§156.1130)
rubrics_metrics.description: Burden associated with developing, submitting, and maintaining QIS materials for QHPs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines required QIS elements and submission timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICRs Regarding Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) — OMB Control Number 0938-1164 (§§158.103, 158.120, 158.210, 158.220)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information collection and reporting related to issuer use of premium revenue and potential MLR adjustments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes reporting forms, data elements, and potential state-specific adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Annual Burden Estimates for Proposed Requirements and Submission of PRA-Related Comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregate presentation of estimated annual administrative burdens for all proposed ICRs and an invitation to comment on PRA estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides tables and methodology for burden estimation and instructions for submitting PRA comments.
